_why: Anti-shrink anchors. A harness that enumerates citations from the document it checks gets GREENER when citations are deleted -- so deleting evidence would be the cheapest way to pass. These floors make that path fail. Raise min_anchored_citations as the doc grows; never lower it to go green. Never raise max_unanchored_citations: positional citations rot silently, which is the defect the harness exists to remove.
_why_continuations: Deictic citations of the form `:123` inherit their file from neighbouring prose. They were invisible to this checker until 97159f1f+: not counted, not ratcheted, not resolved, so a green run reporting 'positional 0' measured a strict subset of the document. Frozen here so the count can only fall. Never raise it.
